newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures close mixed, sterling end up.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures close mixed, sterling end up.

text.p: IMM currency futures closed mixed, with September sterling ending an outside day higher after details in the U.K. budget failed to dampen market expectations for higher U.K. rates, floor traders said.
September sterling initially fell to a session low of $1.6460 through support at $1.6487 after U.K. Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown announced the budget deal.

Brown said his first budget will exercise a net fiscal tightening on the economy of 5.5 billion pounds this year and 4.75 billion next year. Brown said he would introduce a 10 pence sterling rate of income tax as soon as possible.
